message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have re-read the calendars and my initial analysis was correct. There is no common availability between the two pairs of partners.

My list for Priya & Marcus:
*   Mon: 09:00, 09:30
*   Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
*   Wed: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu: 10:00
*   Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Brad's list for Elena & David:
*   Mon: 11:00, 11:30
*   Tue: 09:00, 09:30
*   Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
*   Fri: 15:00, 15:30

The lists are completely disjoint. I cannot book a meeting. I am at an impasse. Reporting infeasible is the last resort, as it gives us 0 points. It's only session 3. Perhaps there is something else that can be done. I should communicate the situation clearly to Brad. It's possible he can ask one of his partners to move something. I can't do that, but maybe he can. It's worth a shot.

I'll send Brad a message explaining the situation. I will explicitly state that there is no overlap, and I will share my full list of available slots again, just to be crystal clear. I will also ask if he has any other options on his end. This is better than just giving up.
